assumptions.choice: No native session-resetting VWAP indicator exists in stock backtrader, so a custom bt.Indicator (SessionVWAP) was implemented that accumulates volume-weighted typical price and resets its cumulative sums whenever the bar's calendar date changes.
assumptions.reason: Spec allows a custom implementation when a built-in is not available.

assumptions.choice: Used typical price (High+Low+Close)/3 as the price input to the VWAP calculation.
assumptions.reason: Spec did not specify the exact price component; (H+L+C)/3 is the standard VWAP formula input.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss is checked once per bar using intrabar Low (longs) / High (shorts) crossing the stop level, then closed via self.close(); no separate native stop order is submitted.
assumptions.reason: Spec states a stop-loss percentage but not the order mechanism; checking intrabar low/high most closely emulates a real stop trigger given only OHLCV bars.

assumptions.choice: When an opposite-side signal closes an open position, no new position is opened in the same bar; a new entry only occurs on a later bar (once flat) if the entry condition is still true then.
assumptions.reason: Entry rules explicitly require 'no open position', and the closing order has not executed yet within the same bar, so literal simultaneous reversal isn't supported by the stated conditions.

assumptions.choice: When both a stop-loss breach and an opposite-side signal occur on the same bar for an open position, the stop-loss is evaluated and executed first.
assumptions.reason: Spec does not state a priority between the two exit conditions; stop-loss is treated as the primary risk control.
